title: What is US Open prize money?
facts: The winner of the 2025 US Open men's singles receives £3.74m in prize money.
The winner of the 2025 US Open women's singles receives £3.74m in prize money.
The total prize pool for the US Open was increased by 39 percent between 2024 and 2025.
Jannik Sinner received £2.84m for winning the US Open in 2024.
Aryna Sabalenka received £2.84m for winning the US Open in 2024.
The US Open offers a total prize money pool of £67.3m.
The 2025 Wimbledon tournament awarded a total of £53.5m in prize money.
The 2025 Australian Open awarded a total of £47m in prize money.
The 2025 French Open awarded a total of £49m in prize money.
The runner-up in the US Open singles tournament receives £1.87m.
Sara Errani and Andrea Vavassori won the 2025 US Open mixed doubles championship.
Sara Errani and Andrea Vavassori received £736,880 for winning the 2025 US Open mixed doubles.
Casper Ruud and Iga Swiatek were defeated in the final of the 2025 US Open mixed doubles championship.
The winning pairs of the US Open men's and women's doubles tournaments receive approximately £750,000.
A total of £1.2m in prize money is shared across the US Open wheelchair competition.
